overview_description.description: Fasset is a digital banking and financial platform offering interest-free saving, investing, spending, and money transfer services. Its platform provides multi-currency accounts, global debit cards, instant settlements, and access to investments in crypto, stocks, funds, and commodities. Fasset also offers business banking, API services, and over-the-counter trading solutions, with infrastructure powered by blockchain technology.

about_short_description.short_description: Fasset is a digital banking and financial platform offering interest-free saving, investing, spending, and money transfer services.

product.name: Fasset App
product.description: A stablecoin-powered financial account for holding, transferring, spending, and investing across fiat currencies, digital assets, stocks, and commodities.

product.name: Fasset Card
product.description: A Visa payment card that lets customers spend from their available Fasset balance at merchants worldwide, with digital-wallet support and rewards on selected tiers.

product.name: Fasset Business Banking
product.description: A business finance platform offering USD, EUR, and GBP accounts, corporate cards, contractor payouts, and a Shariah-compliant profit-sharing treasury option.

product.name: Fasset OTC Desk
product.description: An institutional trading desk for high-value digital-asset transactions, providing quoted execution, dedicated relationship support, and bank or wallet settlement.

product.name: Fasset API
product.description: An API-based financial infrastructure suite for integrating digital-asset trading, wallets, multi-currency accounts, transfers, settlements, and tokenized assets.

product.name: Fasset Pay
product.description: A business payments service for accepting and making payments in virtual assets at scale.
